depth: Rebuild + fill gaps: re-cut every card into desktop/templates/CHARACTER_CARD_TEMPLATE.md, build the head from the card, fill missing required pieces (Refusal, aura colour and sound, combat grammar, tell+counter per Trait, sample line, physical description) from the card's own lore; canon on use, Isaac strikes what he dislikes. Prose not rewritten.
releases: Design them now for every Stage IV+ card (First from IV, Second from VII, Third from IX), built from Traits and Wellsprings; core cast releases go to Isaac first.
order: Pilot the core cast (~11 cards), Isaac reads and adjusts, then the rest in batches by culture.
